free_tier.stated: Free tier after the 14-day trial: up to five Basic hosts with 1-day metric retention at no cost; LLM Observability separately has a free tier of up to 40K LLM spans per month with 15-day retention and no credit card
free_tier.notes: The infrastructure allowance is counted in hosts, a unit the vocabulary lacks. Container monitoring is not available for Basic hosts. The trial lasts 14 days and monitors any number of servers.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the pricing, sign-up and API pages quoted name no payload limit

retention.stated: 1-day metric retention on the Free tier; 15-day retention for LLM spans on the LLM Observability free tier

egress.terms: not stated: the pricing page names no charge for reading data back on the Free tier

interface_detail: The Datadog API is an HTTP REST API authenticated with an API key in the DD-API-KEY header, and for some endpoints an application key in DD-APPLICATION-KEY
tooling: the Datadog web app, the REST API and its official client libraries; host metrics come from the Datadog Agent and cloud integrations
chaining: Host metrics for up to five machines with a one-day window: a live view of free VMs, not a history.

limits.value: up to five Basic hosts (a count of hosts, not bytes)

limits_note: Container monitoring is not available for Basic hosts.
binding_note: Metrics older than one day are gone on the Free tier, so the five hosts give a live view and no history.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form marks Business Email, Full Name, Company and Password as required, with a data region that cannot be changed later; Phone is not starred among the required fields, so no phone is required; Google sign-up is offered; the form has no card field. Whether an address at a public mail domain passes as a business email is unverified.
